Free Tools for Bookbinders

Little helpers I built for my own bench, now yours to use. Free, right in your browser, and if one saves you time, pay what you like.

Booklet Imposition

Upload your book as a PDF and get it laid out as printable spreads, ready to fold, nest and sew. Choose how many sheets per signature, add trim allowance and creep compensation, and download the whole book or one signature at a time.

  • Saddle-stitch signatures from any page-sequence PDF
  • Handles multi-signature books
  • Your file never leaves your browser
Open Booklet Imposition

Box Maker

Work out the piece dimensions for Solander and hinged boxes, with a cutting layout and a preview, based on the method from Constructing and Covering Boxes. Measure once, cut once.

  • Solander and hinged box dimensions
  • Cutting layout for your board
  • Live preview as you change sizes
Open Box Maker

Free to use. Pay if you like.

Every tool is free and stays free. You'll find a few ways to say thanks at the bottom of each one.
